NHRA.note: Sections 2, 7 and 9 restrict commercial reproduction, database compilation, automated extraction, and comprehensive regularly updated racing statistics. The 2026 official schedule was reviewed on 2026-10-30, but its full 20-event list was not retained on dev; use an external official schedule link until a rights-compatible feed or written approval is obtained. Do not ingest NHRA results or standings by bot without authorization.

Supercars.note: The 14-round 2026 schedule is staged as factual date/name/venue entries on dev with organizer source attribution. The organizer's travel-site legal notices reserve copyright in site content and compilations; they do not grant a general data-reuse license. Confirm rights and event changes before production use; do not ingest results, photos or standings without permission.
